description: This Java class defines the response type for a 'RetrieveResource' command within a policy management context. It includes methods for constructing instances from parameters or JSON, accessing resource details, and serializing to JSON.

classes.name: RetrieveResourceResponse
classes.description: Represents the response to a RetrieveResource command, encapsulating resource details, policy information, and serialization/deserialization logic.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of RetrieveResourceResponse from parameters or JSON.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the policy ID associated with this response.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the policy entry.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns the retrieved resource as a Resource object.

methods.name: getResourceKey
methods.description: Returns the resource key of the retrieved resource.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the resource.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity JSON, creating a new response instance.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated headers.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Constructs and returns the JSON pointer path to the resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the object’s data to JSON payload.
